title: Does the fork's trigger recover when it reads PRODUCTION-GRADE levels instead of its own?
_no_results_seen: Written before the transplant harness has been run even once. Only FEASIBILITY was smoke-tested beforehand (reconstruct_levels runs symbol-generic in 14ms and emits sane tiered levels for SPY) -- feasibility is not a result.

hypothesis.mechanism: The multi-lane fork replaced the engine's curated level system with a hand-rolled one (swing pivots + prior day/week + price-scaled round numbers). The calibration run showed the production trigger reading curated levels hits 58.23% at +10min (n=881, +4.89 sigma) while the identical filter stack reading fork levels hits 49.06% (n=7489, -1.63 sigma). If levels are the missing input, restoring them should restore the trigger.
hypothesis.specific_missing_ingredient: Production levels include daily_context SHELVES -- supply/demand bands where price actually spent time -- plus tiering (Active/Carry/Reference), sourcing, and expiry. The fork's level set contained NO shelf concept whatsoever. This is the exact object J's market philosophy names: 'supply/demand zones, wait for the return to the zone, structure shift at the zone.'
hypothesis.null: The trigger does not recover. Levels were not the missing input, and the signal family is dead for a third and final time.

why_this_is_not_the_forbidden_re_slice: The kill-list forbids threshold sweeps, 'try more names', and re-slicing the SAME failed data. This changes the INPUT the signal reads -- a different mechanism with a named ingredient and its own frozen prereg. Nothing about the filter thresholds, the symbol set, or the scoring code changes. One variable moves.

method.levels_source: backtest/lib/reconstruct_levels_asof.reconstruct_levels -- pure, no I/O, slices internally to <= as_of_et, already RED-proofed causal by test_reconstruct_levels_asof.py. Verified symbol-generic (0 SPY literals) across the whole chain: reconstruct_levels_asof / refresh_levels_intraday / daily_context / compute_levels.
method.replay: Bar-by-bar over 5-minute history per symbol. At each evaluation bar, levels are reconstructed as-of THAT bar and the fork's build_signal is scored against them. No look-ahead: the reconstructor's own causality guard plus strict bars.iloc[:i+1] slicing.
method._spy_is_the_internal_positive_control: SPY scored 49.8% hit with fork levels. With production-grade levels it should recover materially toward the 58% the production trigger achieves. SPY is therefore the CONTROL that tells us whether the PORT WORKS, separately from whether the edge TRANSFERS to other names. Without this control, a null result is uninterpretable -- broken port and absent edge look identical.

metric_changes_from_the_prior_prereg_and._why_this_section_exists: Changing a metric after a failure is exactly how motivated reasoning launders a null into a pass. Both changes below were derived from the PRODUCTION CONTROL POPULATION (a different dataset -- production's own decision ledger), not from the multi-lane data under test. That is the distinction between a principled respecification and horizon-shopping, and it is stated here BEFORE any result is seen.

headline_horizon.justification: The prior 30-min headline was ASSUMED, never measured. The production control shows the engine's directional edge peaks at +10min (58.23%) and is entirely gone by +60min (49.13%). The horizon is now set by measurement on an independent population.

primary_channel.was: mean signed forward return vs null MAX
primary_channel.now: DIRECTION HIT RATE vs null MAX, with mean return reported alongside and never suppressed
primary_channel.justification: The control demonstrated mean-of-underlying structurally cannot see this engine's edge: production is right ~58% of the time while its mean underlying move is ~0.01%, because the money is a right tail in OPTION premium harvested by exits. Hit rate separated production (+4.89 sigma) from the fork (-1.63 sigma) cleanly. Mean return stays in the report so a hit-rate win with catastrophic mean cannot hide.

statistics.null: Random entries from the SAME symbol-session bar population, same count, same direction mix, N>=200 draws. Signal must beat the null's MAX, not its mean.
statistics.multiple_comparison: Holm across the 3 horizons. Per-symbol results are descriptive.

decision_rule.CONTROL_FAILS_PORT_IS_BROKEN: SPY does NOT recover materially above its 49.8% fork baseline. => The transplant did not actually take. This says NOTHING about the other symbols and must NOT be reported as a verdict on them. Action: debug the port, re-run. A broken port and an absent edge are indistinguishable without this control, which is why it exists.
decision_rule.PASS: SPY recovers materially (>=54% hit at +10min) AND at least half the remaining 8 symbols beat their own null MAX on hit rate at +10min. => The levels were the missing input AND the edge transfers. Authorizes: paper shadow trading on the passing symbols, with the per-ticker evaluation scorecard, behind an explicit human-set flag. Does NOT authorize live money.
decision_rule.PARTIAL_SPY_ONLY: SPY recovers but fewer than half the others beat their null. => Levels are the edge, but the edge is SPY-specific. Report honestly; do NOT arm other names. The correct read is that SPY's curation quality (months of it) is itself the moat, and other names would need equivalent curation history.
decision_rule.FAIL: SPY recovers and the others are null, or nothing recovers with a verified-good port. => The signal family is dead for the third and final time. No fourth variant. Written verdict, lane stays stopped.
decision_rule.what_no_result_authorizes: Nothing here arms live money (J alone, OP-0 #1), changes any SPY production parameter, or modifies the production engine. Paper is the ceiling.

known_confounds_stated_upfront: reconstruct_levels was built and validated for SPY. Running it on NVDA/TSLA/etc is its first use off-symbol; sane-looking output is not proof of sane calibration, and its distance-from-spot band is a SPY-dollar constant that must be ATR-relative before any non-SPY result is trusted.

SPY's production levels benefit from months of curation and multi-day memory the other names have never had. A SPY-only recovery is therefore the EXPECTED outcome under one plausible reading, and is pre-committed above as PARTIAL, not as a pass.
Stage A measures the SIGNAL on the UNDERLYING. It does not price spread or theta, which only makes a real result worse, never better.
